hint.freeze-runner.1: Watch how recording time affects trail.
hint.motion-and-light.3: Raise ISO or open aperture after shortening shutter.
hint.low-light-runner.1: In low light every decision costs.
hint.separate-subject.3: Open aperture (smaller f) for more background blur.
hint.keep-context.3: Try f/8 or f/11 and compensate with ISO.
hint.portrait-tradeoff.1: Seek balance between separation and noise.
hint.portrait-tradeoff.2: Aperture gives separation but needs light.
hint.recover-exposure.3: Raise ISO to expose within 0.75 stops.
hint.avoid-noise.3: Open aperture before raising ISO above 400.
hint.protect-tones.3: Stop down or faster shutter; lower ISO.
hint.one-stop-exchange.2: Compensate with shutter to keep exposure.
hint.one-stop-exchange.3: If you open 2 stops, speed up shutter 2 stops.
hint.same-exposure-different-image.1: Two photos same light different motion.
hint.same-exposure-different-image.2: Change shutter and compensate with ISO/aperture.
hint.same-exposure-different-image.3: Seek Δ motion ≥6px with Δ exposure ≤0.5.
hint.distance-and-background.3: Keep framing ±15% and seek background difference.
hint.editorial-portrait.3: Seek background 5–10px blur and low noise.
hint.runner-at-dusk.3: Open aperture and raise ISO moderately.
hint.intentional-panning.3: Enable panning and try 1/30 with motion.
reference.title: Reference sheet
reference.oneStop: One stop = double/half light. Eg f/2.8→f/4, 1/60→1/125, ISO100→ISO200.
reference.focalCategories: 24mm wide, 35mm wide-moderate, 50mm normal, 85mm short tele, 135mm tele.
reference.causeEffect: Aperture ↓ → more light + shallower depth. Shutter ↑ time → more light + more motion. ISO ↑ → more light + more noise. Focal ↑ → tighter framing + blurrier background.
